source_claim: Official Steam catalog pages for Orange_Juice-developed SUGURI-universe games explicitly identify Suguri, Sora, Hime, Star Breaker, and Marc across the SUGURI, Sora, 100% Orange Juice, and Flying Red Barrel products. The pages identify Orange_Juice as developer and Orange Juice as the franchise/universe; they state that Acceleration of SUGURI 2 is a direct sequel to Sora and that Star Breaker is from Sora.
notes: Official source routes: the SUGURI Steam page identifies the SUGURI title as created by Orange_Juice and centers Suguri (https://store.steampowered.com/app/262240/SUGURI/); the Sora page identifies Sora as its namesake protagonist and Orange_Juice as developer (https://store.steampowered.com/app/390730/Sora/); the official 100% Orange Juice Suguri & Hime Winter Costume DLC calls them the popular duo from the SUGURI series and states they are both unlockable characters (https://store.steampowered.com/app/583640/100_Orange_Juice__Suguri__Hime_Winter_Costumes/); the official Breaker Pack names Star Breaker as a playable character from Sora and says its characters come from Orange_Juice games (https://store.steampowered.com/app/465480/100_Orange_Juice__Breaker_Pack/); Marc is included in the official 100% Orange Juice publisher announcement as a playable bonus character tied to the Orange_Juice-developed Flying Red Barrel game (https://store.steampowered.com/news/posts/?appids=282800&enddate=1593115256&feed=steam_community_announcements). The Sora product page lists Orange_Juice as developer; the official Acceleration of SUGURI 2 page identifies the Orange Juice franchise, SUGURI universe, and direct sequel relationship to Sora.
